feature_contract.goal: Prevent double or head-locked original gameplay ScreenHud shader glyphs caused by native left/right GPU stereo using different queued or direct physical HUD sources after a synchronous game callback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only source-tagged R84 native shader ScreenHud; no change to untagged overlays, fixed function, GOAL, +TIME, lens C993, SkyGlow, car world, R26_SAFE rollback, original gamepad or FFB.
trace_stages: Original OutRun game HUD producer and optional SpriteNode tag form exact physical GPU DrawCommand scope, producer, queue pointer and epoch.
R84 R30 builds source-screen left/right constants at the shader c64 rendering boundary; native R33 left Draw can reenter another original HUD producer.
R84 R33 captures physical owner, live shader, pose epoch and native draw serial before left and repeats after successful left prior to right-eye upload.
On mismatch, R33 restores the original game's vertex constants, fails the stereo frame and preserves original single left Draw HRESULT.
subcomponents: Native R84 GPU stereo physical HUD source capture and right-eye veto with original c64 restore and no replay.
Portable typed original physical-command conversion and reentrant queue/direct positive/negative HUD tests.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original direct and queued glyph source through native shader HUD GPU eyes
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both eyes use one physical source identity including same producer, SpriteNode, shader, pose and draw serial.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Foreign reentrant SpriteNode and shader native callback, GOAL, world and R26 rollback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: If HUD owner changes, restore original GPU c64, do not issue a foreign right Draw and preserve normal original left draw return.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Windows x86/x64 and original scene/host package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required exact SHA GitHub Actions policy, game, host, full-chain, package, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source gates pass; Quest3 hardware remains untested.

diagnosis.root_cause: R84 R33TryHud already enforced native left/right source comparison for lens C993, player shadow and stage +TIME/GOAL, but lacked corresponding validation for normal source-proven ScreenHud shader draws even though the HudNativeSource predicate existed only in portable tests.
diagnosis.original_evidence: At exact baseline 82bdc915b42fd0451b1da726f7ec317c93a4c0c8, R33TryHud follows native left actualDraw with four specialized source predicates, with no generic exact ScreenHud source predicate before right-eye c64 upload.
source_trace: GameSemantic::CapturePhysicalDrawCommand owns the tagged physical HUD glyph and optional queued SpriteNode epoch.
R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants constructs the left and right eye vertex constants.
R33TryHud invokes original left actualDraw, where native callbacks can mutate producer, shader, queue and pose before right eye.
alternatives_rejected: Do not adopt global ScreenOverlay ownership, disable original drawing, flush D3DX in every draw or rescale all HUD without source evidence.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: A complete native source stamp must remain identical across both R33 physical HUD eyes; a changed source after left disallows right-eye draw and triggers restoration.
